MemeDef.label: horde riders
MemeDef.description: The saddle is our home; to walk is to be lesser. Our people ride everywhere, fight from horseback, and mourn the mounts that fall beneath them.

rulesStrings.li: creation(tag=meme_Ordo_HordeRiders) ->[deity0_name] made the first steed from the wind and gave it to the first rider, so that no [memberName] would ever walk alone.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Ordo_HordeRiders) ->The riders of [deity0_name] crossed the world in a single season, and the earth shook beneath them.
intro(tag=meme_Ordo_HordeRiders) ->On the [place_summary] [place_name], the [memberNamePlural] followed the herds and never slept twice in the same place.
conflict(tag=meme_Ordo_HordeRiders) ->A walled [foeLeader] tried to fence the plains, and [foeLeader_possessive] [foeSoldiers] slaughtered the herds with [place_personalWeapon]s.
founderJoin(tag=meme_Ordo_HordeRiders) ->A [place_job] named [founderName] tamed a horse no one else could ride.
victory(tag=meme_Ordo_HordeRiders) ->[founderName] led the [memberNamePlural] in a charge that broke the walls of the [foeSoldiers], and the plains were free again.
setup(tag=meme_Ordo_HordeRiders) ->[founderName] grew up among the herders of a frontier world, where a pawn without a mount was a pawn without a future.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_Ordo_HordeRiders) ->[founderName] gathered the scattered riders into one horde and taught them to fight from the saddle.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_Ordo_HordeRiders) ->My grandmother put me on a horse before I could walk. When I asked her why, she told me
lesson(tag=meme_Ordo_HordeRiders) ->a people on foot can be caught, but a people in the saddle can never be held
archistBasis(tag=meme_Ordo_HordeRiders) ->The archotechs move across the stars as our riders move across the plains: swift, untiring, never bound to one place.
archistFact(tag=meme_Ordo_HordeRiders) ->Rider and mount together are more than either alone, as human and archotech will one day be.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_Ordo_HordeRiders) ->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will send a steed for every rider who never once chose to walk.
animistBasis(tag=meme_Ordo_HordeRiders) ->Every mount carries a spirit of the open wind, and it shares that spirit with whoever rides it.
animistFact(tag=meme_Ordo_HordeRiders) ->A rider who walks when they could ride insults the spirit of their mount.
animistProphecy(tag=meme_Ordo_HordeRiders) ->[itIsSaid] that the wielder of the [relic0_name] will hear every hoofbeat in the world at once.
